title: 394 Campus Recruiters & Internship Companies in India (2026–27): Salaries and Official Websites | Xobin News
text:
Which companies should you shortlist for campus recruitment in India? Start with employers recorded recruiting from one or more campuses, compare their reported packages carefully, then check their official websites for recruitment instructions.
Pro tip
Important: Xobin is not a job application platform for students and does not provide a student assessment-practice portal. Xobin is a selection and assessment tool used by employers to evaluate and hire talent. You cannot apply for jobs or practise recruitment assessments through Xobin. To explore openings, visit each company's official website and follow its recruitment instructions.
These figures reflect observed campus recruitment packages, not guaranteed starting salaries or confirmation of current openings. Hiring windows and eligibility vary by company and campus. Check official careers sites and your placement office for active applications.
This guide is for graduates, placement-seeking students, and people looking for internships in India. It combines recorded company-level campus recruitment examples, including historical figures, rather than a representative nationwide sample or a live vacancy tracker. Packages can vary substantially by campus, role and year. The source coverage includes earlier-year recruiter and internship-host examples, so not every entry represents a 2026–27 placement or internship. Do not assume that every figure is from the 2026–27 season.

How to read this list
Highest reported campus CTC is a recorded maximum, not an expected offer.
All amounts are in Indian rupees, expressed as lakh per annum (INR LPA). They are not averages, guaranteed graduate salaries or salary ranges.
Not disclosed means the package is unavailable.
Missing figures are never replaced with zero or market estimates.
Outliers need context.
Rubrik's ₹160 LPA, Google's ₹55 LPA and Adobe's ₹50 LPA are campus-specific recorded examples. They must not be read as typical annual compensation for graduates in India. Check the relevant role, year and salary breakup before comparing them.
Historical examples are marked.
Freshworks (₹5 LPA) and Wipro (₹4.5 LPA) are earlier-year examples, not confirmed 2026–27 packages. Their exact earlier years are not specified.
Two small amounts need extra caution.
Nokia (₹0.3 LPA) and Panasonic Avionics India Pvt. Ltd. (₹0.4 LPA) may be internship or portal-coded amounts. They are preserved as recorded, not presented as typical annual graduate salaries.
Company links are official homepages, not application links.
A link does not confirm recruitment is open. Some names remain unlinked where the exact corporate identity could not be verified.

Where to check fresher jobs and internship openings
Start at the employer's official website.
Open a linked company name in the directory and look for its Careers, Jobs or Students section. Follow that employer's instructions only if a relevant opening is actually listed. For unlinked names, confirm the exact company identity before sharing personal details.
Use your campus placement channels.
Ask your placement office about participating employers, eligibility rules, registration deadlines and the authorised application process. A company in this directory may not recruit from your campus.
Check the details of any off-campus listing.
Confirm the role, experience requirement, location, closing date and contact details against the employer's own website. Do not assume an application is open because a salary appears here.
Keep a simple application record.
Track only openings you have actually verified, with the employer, role, official URL, deadline and status. Treat messages asking for recruitment fees or sensitive information cautiously and verify them with the employer.
CTC vs take-home: compare the salary breakup
CTC (cost to company) is not your monthly bank credit. Depending on the offer, it can include employer provident fund contributions, gratuity, insurance, variable pay, one-time bonuses or equity that vests over time.
Ask for the fixed-pay component, variable-pay conditions and payment schedule. Compare recurring cash compensation separately from benefits, bonuses and stock. Dividing a headline CTC by twelve does not establish your monthly take-home salary.
Build a shortlist that fits you
Start with eligibility and interests.
Use the employer's actual recruitment requirements, not assumptions about a company's selection process.
Compare roles before packages.
A reported maximum may belong to a different role, campus or year from the opportunity you are considering.
Keep more than one option.
Prioritise companies whose verified opportunities match your skills and preferences, rather than relying on the largest historical number.
Prepare through appropriate learning resources.
Review your fundamentals, project work and interview readiness. Xobin does not offer students an assessment-practice portal.

Frequently asked questions
Are these companies hiring in India right now?
Not necessarily. These are recorded campus recruitment examples, not verified real-time openings. Presence in the directory does not confirm a vacancy, participation at your campus or an open application window. Check the employer’s official website and your placement office.
What does highest reported campus CTC mean?
It is the highest recorded campus cost-to-company figure supplied for that company, not an average or guaranteed graduate salary. Historical packages vary by campus, role and year. Rubrik, Google and Adobe include campus-specific outlier examples, not typical salary claims.
Why do some companies show Not disclosed?
A package figure was not available for those entries. Not disclosed is not zero, and no market estimate has been substituted.
Can I apply for a job or practise recruitment assessments through Xobin?
Are Freshworks and Wipro figures from 2026–27?
No. Freshworks at ₹5 LPA and Wipro at ₹4.5 LPA are historical earlier-year examples. The exact earlier years are not specified, and these figures do not establish current packages or openings.
How were these packages compiled?
This directory combines recorded company-level campus recruitment examples from one or more campuses, including earlier-year examples. It is not an independently researched nationwide sample. The original observations were from September 2026 and the expanded article was edited in October 2026. All figures are retained as supplied; coverage and data vintage vary by entry.
Is CTC the same as take-home salary?
No. CTC can include benefits, employer contributions, variable pay, one-time bonuses and equity. Ask the employer for the fixed-pay component and full salary breakup before comparing offers.
Why is an internship company's salary Not disclosed?
The internship-host records do not supply reliable company-specific stipend figures. Annual campus CTC should not be treated as a monthly stipend. We show Not disclosed instead of guessing.
Do these 394 companies all have active internship openings right now?
No. The directory combines historical internship-host and campus recruitment records. A company's inclusion does not confirm a current vacancy. Open listings must be checked on the employer's official careers page.
